import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.HasseDeriv
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Taylor
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.ToLinearEquiv
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.Wronskian
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Vandermonde
import Mathlib.Data.ZMod.Defs
import Mathlib.Algebra.Field.ZMod
import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Group.Int.Sum
#check_failure Roth.sum_range_le_sum_of_injective
#check @Finset.sum_range_le_sum
#check @Finset.sum_Ico_le_sum
#check @Finset.card_image_of_injective
#check @Finset.sum_image
#check @Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range
#check @Nat.cast_sum
namespace SumInjectiveProbe
theorem original {l : ℕ} (d : Fin l → ℕ) (hd : Function.Injective d) :
    ∑ ν : Fin l, (ν : ℕ) ≤ ∑ ν, d ν := by
  exact_mod_cast (show ((∑ ν : Fin l, (ν : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤
      ((∑ ν, d ν : ℕ) : ℤ) by
    simpa [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hd, Finset.sum_image hd.injOn,
      ← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range, Nat.cast_sum] using
      Finset.sum_range_le_sum (s := (Finset.univ.image d).map Nat.castEmbedding)
        (c := 0) (by simp))
theorem integer_finite {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (d : ι → ℤ)
    (hd : Function.Injective d) (c : ℤ) (hc : ∀ i, c ≤ d i) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (Fintype.card ι), (c + n)) ≤ ∑ i, d i := by
  classical
  simpa [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hd, Finset.sum_image hd.injOn] using
    (Finset.sum_range_le_sum (s := Finset.univ.image d) (c := c) (by simpa using hc))
theorem canonical (s : Finset ℤ) (c : ℤ) (hs : ∀ x ∈ s, c ≤ x) :
    ∑ n ∈ Finset.range s.card, (c + n) ≤ ∑ x ∈ s, x := Finset.sum_range_le_sum hs
theorem injectivity_needed :
    ¬ (∑ i : Fin 2, (i : ℕ) ≤ ∑ _i : Fin 2, (0 : ℕ)) := by decide
end SumInjectiveProbe
#print axioms SumInjectiveProbe.original
#print axioms SumInjectiveProbe.integer_finite
#print axioms SumInjectiveProbe.canonical
#print axioms SumInjectiveProbe.injectivity_needed

namespace SumInjectiveDenseGuard
theorem input_injective : Function.Injective (![0, (1 / 2 : ℚ)] : Fin 2 → ℚ) := by decide
theorem input_nonnegative : ∀ i : Fin 2, 0 ≤ (![0, (1 / 2 : ℚ)] : Fin 2 → ℚ) i := by decide
theorem bound_fails :
    ¬ ((∑ i : Fin 2, (i : ℚ)) ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, (![0, (1 / 2 : ℚ)] : Fin 2 → ℚ) i) := by
  norm_num [Fin.sum_univ_two]
#print axioms input_injective
#print axioms input_nonnegative
#print axioms bound_fails
end SumInjectiveDenseGuard
